d.name: Ludicolo

abilities.name: Excited Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have any Grass Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

d.name: Genesect

attacks.name: Bug's Cannon

d.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

d.name: Nymble

attacks.name: Flail Around
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.name: Lokix

attacks.name: Jumping Shot
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

d.flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

d.name: Charmander

abilities.name: Agile
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has no Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

d.name: Charmeleon
d.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

d.name: Mega Charizard X ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Inferno X
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Fire Energy from among your Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

d.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Fighting Wings
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

d.name: Darumaka

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

d.name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

d.name: Reshiram

attacks.name: Burning Flare
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

d.name: Oricorio ex

abilities.name: Excited Turbo

d.name: Charcadet

attacks.name: Gather Strength
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

d.name: Ceruledge

attacks.name: Infernal Slash
attacks.text: Discard 4 Basic Fire Energy cards from your hand. If you can't discard 4 cards in this way, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

d.name: Seel

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

d.name: Dewgong

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Fire or Water Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

d.name: Swinub
d.flavorText: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

d.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

d.name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Blizzard Edge
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.name: Suicune

attacks.name: Crystal Fall
attacks.text: If you have at least 4 Water Energy in play, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

d.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Call for Support
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

d.name: Prinplup

attacks.name: Targeted Dive

d.name: Boltund

attacks.name: Electric Run
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 more damage.

d.flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

d.name: Pawmi

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

d.name: Pawmo
d.flavorText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

d.name: Pawmot

attacks.name: Voltaic Fist
attacks.text: You may have this Pokémon also do 60 damage to itself and make your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

d.name: Misdreavus
d.flavorText: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

d.name: Mismagius ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

d.name: Snubbull
d.flavorText: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

d.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Swelling Light

attacks.name: Soothing Melody

attacks.name: Sweet Circle

d.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Poison Ring

attacks.name: Double Headbutt

attacks.name: Ambush

d.name: Sableye

d.name: Absol

attacks.name: Allure

d.flavorText: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

d.name: Sandile
d.flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

d.name: Krokorok
d.flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

d.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Vengeful Fang
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 160 more damage.

d.flavorText: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

d.name: Toxel

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

d.name: Zangoose ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spike Draw

attacks.name: Wild Scissors
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.name: Larry's Starly

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

d.name: Larry's Staravia
d.flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

d.name: Larry's Staraptor

attacks.name: Facade
attacks.text: If this Pokémon is Burned or Poisoned, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Feathery Strike
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

abilities.name: Fan Call
abilities.text: Once during your first turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Colorless Pokémon with 100 HP or less, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Fan Call Ability during your turn.

attacks.name: Assault Landing
attacks.text: If there is no Stadium in play, this attack does nothing.

d.name: Larry's Rufflet

attacks.name: Peck the Wound
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.

d.flavorText: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

d.name: Larry's Braviary

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

d.name: Larry's Komala

abilities.name: Lethargic Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may use this Ability. Attach an Energy card from your hand to your Active Larry's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dozing Draw
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Draw 2 cards.

d.flavorText: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala’s drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.

d.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Dragon Strike
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Dragon Strike.

d.flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

d.name: Hop's Cramorant

attacks.name: Fickle Spitting
attacks.text: If your opponent doesn't have exactly 3 or 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They’re at their most formidable when they’re struggling to swallow overly large prey.

d.name: Terapagos

attacks.name: Prism Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Tera Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

abilities.name: Gathering of Blossoms
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for an Erika's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

d.name: Beautifly

attacks.name: Stun Spore

attacks.name: Energy Straw
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and this attack does 80 damage for each Energy card you find there.

abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

attacks.name: Twilight Poison

d.name: Budew

attacks.name: Itchy Pollen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

d.name: Ethan's Magcargo

abilities.name: Melt Away

attacks.name: Lava Burst
attacks.text: Discard up to 5 Fire Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

d.name: Numel

abilities.name: Incandescent Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

d.name: Salazzle

attacks.name: Sudden Scorching
attacks.text: Your opponent discards a card from their hand. If this Pokémon evolved from Salandit during this turn, your opponent discards 2 more cards.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group.

d.name: Scorbunny

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

d.flavorText: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

d.name: Psyduck

abilities.name: Damp

d.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

d.name: Snorunt
d.flavorText: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

d.name: Weavile

attacks.name: Hail Claw
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

d.name: Heliolisk

abilities.name: Frilled Generator
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you played Canari from your hand this turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Powerful Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

d.name: Vikavolt

attacks.name: Volt Switch
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Lightning Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

d.name: Iono's Wattrel

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

d.name: Marill

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

d.name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.name: Banette

attacks.name: Cursed Words

d.name: Togekiss

abilities.name: Wonder Kiss
abilities.text: When your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, take 1 more Prize card. The effect of Wonder Kiss doesn't stack.

d.flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

d.name: Slurpuff
d.flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

d.name: Hop's Trevenant

attacks.name: Horrifying Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Hop's Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Gemstone Mimicry
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Tera Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

d.name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio

abilities.name: Holes
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

d.flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

d.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Spin and Draw

d.flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

attacks.name: Seventh Kick
attacks.text: If you don't have exactly 7 cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Fighting and Psychic type.

attacks.name: Counter Jewel
attacks.text: If your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 100 more damage.

d.name: Mightyena

attacks.name: Kick Away
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

d.name: Cynthia's Spiritomb

attacks.name: Raging Curse
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Cynthia's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

attacks.name: Scarring Shout
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Punk Smash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

d.name: Dreepy
d.flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

abilities.name: Recon Directive
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

d.name: Kakuna

d.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

d.name: Chespin

d.name: Quilladin

d.flavorText: Its tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

d.name: Vulpix

d.flavorText: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

d.flavorText: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

d.name: Braixen

attacks.name: Flamethrower

d.flavorText: It keeps a twig in its tail. Using friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

attacks.name: Energized Storm

d.flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

d.name: Litleo

attacks.name: Collect

d.name: Frogadier

d.name: Bergmite
d.flavorText: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

d.name: Avalugg

attacks.name: Iceberg Breaker

d.flavorText: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

d.name: Wimpod
d.flavorText: It's nature's cleaner-it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

d.name: Golisopod

attacks.name: Boundless Power

d.name: Mareep

attacks.name: Thunder Wave

d.flavorText: Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

d.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Disconnect

d.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire wool that zaps on impact.

d.name: Ampharos

attacks.name: Flashing Bolt

d.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

d.name: Meowstic

attacks.name: Tricky Steps
attacks.text: You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

d.name: Phantump

abilities.name: Spiteful Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Choose a card in your hand that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. If you do, place 2 damage counters on the Pokémon you evolved in this way. You can't use this Ability during your first turn.

d.flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

d.name: Trevenant

attacks.name: Cursed Roots
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, Energy can't be attached from your opponent's hand to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Overwhelming Pain
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent's Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

d.name: Pumpkaboo
d.flavorText: It was recently discovered that the different varieties of Pumpkaboo vary not only in size but also in the size of the souls they collect.

d.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

d.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

d.name: Phanpy
d.flavorText: It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter.

d.name: Donphan

attacks.name: No Reprieve

attacks.name: Smashing Headbutt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.name: Baltoy

d.flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

d.name: Claydol

attacks.text: If this Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 150 more damage.

attacks.name: Supersonic

d.flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

d.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Covert Flight

d.name: Crobat

abilities.name: Nighttime Maneuvers
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a card. Shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of it.

attacks.name: Poison Sound Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

d.flavorText: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

d.name: Qwilfish

attacks.name: Venoshock

d.flavorText: Experienced fishers say they try to catch Qwilfish in the brief moment that these Pokemon become defenseless just after launching poisonous spikes.

d.name: Stunky
d.flavorText: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

d.name: Skuntank

attacks.name: Acid Spray

rules: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player draws a card for each of his or her remaining Prize cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Palkia LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Palkia. Palkia LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Restructure
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, you switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Palkia is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Reflect
attacks.text: You may move all Energy cards attached to Palkia to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. (Ignore this effect if you don't have any Benched Pokémon.)

d.name: M Gardevoir-EX
rules: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Brilliant Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the number of Fairy Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

d.name: Shining Celebi
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Celebi in your deck.

attacks.name: Healing Water
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of Water Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Miracle Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).

d.name: Scizor ex
rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Danger Perception
abilities.text: As long as Scizor ex's remaining HP is 60 or less, Scizor ex does 40 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Scizor ex by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolved Pokémon, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

d.name: Mew VMAX
rules: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Cross Fusion Strike
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your Benched Fusion Strike Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Max Miracle
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.name: Arceus VSTAR
rules: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Starbirth
abilities.text: During your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

attacks.name: Trinity Nova
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon V in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.name: Zacian V
rules: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Intrepid Sword
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Metal Energy cards you find there to this Pokémon. Put the other cards into your hand. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

attacks.name: Brave Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Fire, Water, or Psychic basic Energy card from your hand to Lugia, Lugia's type (color) becomes the same as that Energy card type until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage times the number of Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Steam Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to Lugia.
